caveats: labels are cross-family LLM judgments, not human labels; the certificate covers the judge's notion of correctness
the certificate is over the calibration draw and the selection rule; test risk is reported separately and is not covered by it
the consistency population's base error is dominated by sibling-document ambiguity (CNS-2); the bench population is the product's own frozen test split
two decision-time features (numeric consistency, claim support) need the full answer text and are unavailable on the bench population
label_source: cross-family LLM judge (deepseek-flash), not human labels

n_required.note: rows needed for a certificate at the given alpha/delta when the accepted region has zero observed errors; more rows are needed when the observed risk is non-zero (the UCB grows with sqrt(risk * log(1/delta) / n))
